github-dark.name: GitHub Dark
github-dark.why: Accent is Primer's accent.fg. The selection is the foreground (inverted); the guard replaces it.

catppuccin-mocha.name: Catppuccin Mocha
catppuccin-mocha.why: Accent is mauve from the official palette (Ghostty has no accent). Normal slots: Ghostty's bright 9-13 are re-saturated copies, the official red/green/yellow/blue are the normal ones. Keywords mauve and numbers peach, as Catppuccin's own syntax style guide.

graphite-dark.name: Graphite Dark
graphite-dark.upstream: Code Foundry's original dark theme (index.css .dark before theme-slots-1)
graphite-dark.why: The pre-engine neutral theme, hand-picked rather than derived (Tailwind's neutral greys), so its base is literal and the slots where the rules land elsewhere are overrides: the near-black text on its light-grey primary button, the grey focus ring, the selected sidebar row (the rule's 10% toward white is near-black on a black sheet) and the terminal's inactive selection.

dracula.name: Dracula
dracula.why: Dracula's blue slot is purple (#bd93f9, bright #d6acff), the accent; info/link/Working use cyan instead so they do not look like buttons. Normal slots are the official palette.

gruvbox-dark.name: Gruvbox Dark
gruvbox-dark.why: Accent is Gruvbox's bright orange (not in the ANSI palette).

nord.name: Nord
nord.why: Accent is frost nord8. Destructive (#bf616a, 3.1:1) and the inverted selection are fixed by the guards.

rose-pine.name: Rosé Pine
rose-pine.why: Accent is iris. Rosé Pine has no green: its ANSI green is pine (blue-teal), which does not read as done; success is the palette's leaf (sage) instead.

solarized-dark.name: Solarized Dark
solarized-dark.why: Solarized's bright slots are its greys (and bright red is orange), so status colours use the normal accents. Accent is blue. The foreground (4.8:1) is lifted to 7:1 by the guard.

monokai-pro.name: Monokai Pro
monokai-pro.why: Accent is Monokai's yellow, which is also its ANSI yellow, so warning takes the orange (ANSI 4, Monokai has no blue) and info takes cyan.

kanagawa-wave.name: Kanagawa Wave
kanagawa-wave.why: Accent is crystalBlue. The selection is the foreground (inverted); the guard replaces it.

everforest-dark-hard.name: Everforest Dark Hard
everforest-dark-hard.why: Accent is Everforest's green. The bright slots are the light variant's saturated, darker colours; on the dark background the normal slots are the theme's own.

ayu-mirage.name: Ayu Mirage
ayu-mirage.why: Accent is Ayu's orange (keyword colour), distinct from its yellow warning. The bright-blue selection is replaced by the guard.

petros-dusk.name: Petros Dusk
petros-dusk.why: Orange on deep purple: the accent is the foreground orange, so primary buttons and the user bubble carry the theme's signature. ANSI blue (#33489c) is 1.9:1 on the purple, so info/link use bright aqua (ANSI 14) instead. Warning (bright yellow #fca503) is close to the body text colour by design. The bright red (3.6:1) and the orange foreground (6.8:1) are lifted by the guards.

github-light.name: GitHub Light
github-light.why: Accent is Primer's blue. ANSI yellow is near-black brown (#4d2d00), so warning is Primer's attention.fg. The selection is the foreground (inverted); the guard replaces it.

catppuccin-latte.name: Catppuccin Latte
catppuccin-latte.why: Accent is lavender from the official palette (#7287fd), not mauve. Lavender is too light for text on or under it, so the accent rule darkens it at the same hue to #5363d5. Keywords stay mauve and numbers peach, as Catppuccin's syntax style guide, darkened at the same hue to 4.5:1 on the base and on code blocks (mauve #8839ef -> #8433ea, peach #fe640b -> #b24200): overrides are final values, not guarded. Yellow and green are too light for text on the light base; the rules darken them.

graphite-light.name: Graphite Light
graphite-light.upstream: Code Foundry's original light theme (index.css :root before theme-slots-1)
graphite-light.why: The pre-engine neutral theme, hand-picked rather than derived (Tailwind's neutral greys), so its base is literal and the slots where the rules land elsewhere are overrides: muted text (the rule gives #4d4d4d), the paler control and sunken greys, the grey focus ring, the field border (the same grey as its borders) and the selected sidebar row.

gruvbox-light.name: Gruvbox Light
gruvbox-light.why: Accent is Gruvbox light's orange. Its bright slots are the darker 'faded' set meant for the light background, so status colours use them. The selection is the foreground (inverted); the guard replaces it.

rose-pine-dawn.name: Rosé Pine Dawn
rose-pine-dawn.why: Accent is iris. Destructive is a redder take on love: the guard darkens Ghostty's love #b4637a to a mauve-pink #9c4d64, so it is set to #b0405a (hue nudged toward red, a little more chroma), which already clears 4.5:1 on pane and sheet. No green (as Rosé Pine): success is Dawn's leaf; info stays foam (ANSI 4) so it is not the same teal as pine. Gold warning is darkened by the guard.

atom-one-light.name: Atom One Light
atom-one-light.why: Accent is One Light's blue. ANSI 8 is black, so code comments use muted-foreground (guard); the pale yellow warning is darkened by the guard.

solarized-light.name: Solarized Light
solarized-light.why: Accent is blue. Solarized is low contrast by design (fg 4.1:1); the guards darken the foreground to 7:1 and every status colour to 4.5:1.
